primitives.name: Football Rule Complexity Growth
primitives.verbatim_quote: FOOT-BALL IN AMERICA 89 rapidly multiplied until the number was quite double that of the original code.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C(t)': 'Total number of football rules at time t', 'C_0': 'Initial rule count (dimensionless)', '\\lambda': 'Rule proliferation rate per year (units: year^{-1})', 't': 'Time elapsed since inception (units: years)'}

primitives.name: Rule Excision Process
primitives.verbatim_quote: Then followed the process of excision, and many of the old English rules which had become useless were dropped.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E(t)': 'Cumulative number of excised rules up to time t (dimensionless)', '\\delta(\\text{usefulness})': 'Dirac delta function testing rule obsolescence (dimensionless)', 't': 'Time (units: years)'}
primitives.assumptions: Excision occurs only when a rule's usefulness drops below a threshold; assumes perfect foresight of future utility.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Regime where excision rate exceeds addition rate leads to net rule reduction; critical point occurs when remaining rules form minimal consistent subset.

layer2.mapping: GSI - Models excision as conformal prediction intervals pruning irrelevant hypotheses; GSE - Tracks state transitions eliminating redundant action sequences.
layer2.telemetry: Historical record of removed rules provides direct telemetry for \delta(\text{usefulness}) functional form.

primitives.name: Rules Committee Legislative Cycle
primitives.verbatim_quote: This Rules Committee was called into being by the University Athletic Club of New York, at the request of several of the colleges.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_{\\text{cycle}}': 'Annual legislative cycle duration (units: years)', 'T_{\\text{proposal}}': 'Time for rule proposals to reach committee (units: years)', 'T_{\\text{review}}': 'Duration of committee deliberation (units: years)', 'T_{\\text{approval}}': 'Time for final ratification (units: years)'}
primitives.assumptions: Cycle operates on a fixed annual cadence; assumes linear sequential processing without parallelization or feedback loops.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity arises when cycle time diverges due to stakeholder disagreement, causing governance gridlock.

layer2.mapping: GSI - Maps legislative cycle to posterior updating in multi-agent belief systems; GSE - Transitions between governance states based on committee decisions.
layer2.telemetry: Actual legislative cycle times serve as empirical metrics for each component term.

primitives.name: Informal Conference Collaboration
primitives.verbatim_quote: This most excellent state of affairs was the result of suggestions emanating from an informal conference held some years ago in New York, at which were present members of the faculties of Harvard, Princeton, and Yale.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S': 'Quality of collaborative suggestions (dimensionless)', 'N': 'Number of participating institutions (dimensionless)', 'P(N)': 'Probability of productive interaction given N participants (dimensionless)'}

primitives.breakdown_regime: Regime where coordination cost exceeds marginal benefit causes collaboration failure; critical point occurs at optimal N*.

layer2.mapping: GSI - Treats faculty collaboration as message-passing networks optimizing collective intelligence; GSE - Models strategic coalitions forming around rule modifications.
layer2.telemetry: Historical success rates of conferences with varying N provide empirical calibration for P(N).
